[element-annotation]
=== `<annotation>` Annotation (in a citation)

Commentary, summary, review, or similar non-bibliographic information concerning the cited work that is found in a citation.

#### Related Elements

This element is not related to the MathML `<annotation>` element, which is a mathematical term used only within MathML equations.
